subject: Is there a mechanism to browse the applications that i have on my shiny server (via the browser)?

messages.author: 46357c53c3c67654
messages.subject: Is there a mechanism to browse the applications that i have on my shiny server (via the browser)?
parts:
So a noob question. If i have multiple applications, can i browse the "directory" of applications? 

I guess the fundamental questions are: 
  • do i have to know about the app before i can get to it? 
  • do i have to build a "menu page" with links to apps manually? 
  • what's available and what's best practice? 
Thanks for any help.
Regards,
Matt

messages.author: f66be21d595ccb8b
messages.subject: Re: Is there a mechanism to browse the applications that i have on my shiny server (via the browser)?
parts:
Kinda curious how you wouldn't know about them, but:
  • It should be at the base URL by default (https://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#host-a-directory-of-applications)
  • Shiny Pro has a directory in the admin console ({URL}:4151/#/application).
  • Through the command line, they are should all be in /srv/shiny-server/. You could even `ls` this via Console in RStudio Server if that's available.
  • As far as stylizing a directory, I think you can just put an index.html file in /srv/shiny-server/.
Chris
